method: Anonymous MCP tools/list and list_buyer_jobs only

tools.name: list_buyer_jobs
tools.title: List RQM service contracts
tools.description: List quantum service descriptions, input schemas, examples and limitations. Does not execute jobs or quote a binding price.

tools.name: search_buyer_jobs
tools.title: Search RQM service contracts
tools.description: Find public service contracts using a short task description and optional product filter. Returns inputs, examples and limitations; does not compute results or purchase jobs.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.title: Read prepaid RQM balance
tools.description: Read the connected account's prepaid USD balance. Does not fund the account or authorize spending.

tools.name: run_account_job
tools.title: Run a job using prepaid RQM credits
tools.description: Submit one catalog job within the account owner's saved spending policy. Reuse idempotency_key on every retry. This spends prepaid credits; it never signs x402 or funds the account.

tools.name: get_account_job
tools.title: Recover an account-funded job
tools.description: Read this agent's saved job, result and receipt. Never authorizes another purchase.

tools.name: list_account_jobs
tools.title: Find this agent's purchases
tools.description: List up to 100 recent jobs or recover the original purchase using its idempotency key.
